name: 金币
source: 主线任务奖励、海域宝箱、击败敌舰掉落、港口商店出售物品、日常活动
sourceEn: Main quest rewards, sea area chests, defeating enemy ships, selling items at port shops, daily activities

name: 招募券
source: 每周 50% 概率从船员招募中获得黑券级船员或往日之影（保底三周一个），完成周常任务、活动奖励
sourceEn: 50% chance per week to get Black Ticket-rarity crew or Shadow of the Past from recruitment (3-week pity), weekly tasks, event rewards

name: 记忆碎片
source: 完成浅表梦境挑战、海域 Roguelite 关卡掉落、大记忆之塔进度奖励
sourceEn: Complete Shallow Dream challenges, drops from sea Roguelite stages, Memory Tower progress rewards

name: 船员玉
source: 完成港口委托、海域探索奖励、分解多余船员、商店兑换
sourceEn: Port commissions, sea exploration rewards, decomposing duplicate crew, shop exchange

name: 漂流瓶碎片
source: 漂流瓶号船队专属突破材料，漂流海域普通/精英怪掉落、港口商店兑换、活动奖励
sourceEn: Drift Bottle faction exclusive ascension material, drops from Drift Sea normal/elite enemies, port shop exchange, event rewards

name: 流浪者徽章
source: 流浪号船队专属突破材料，流浪号相关海域掉落、活动奖励、商店兑换
sourceEn: Wanderer faction exclusive ascension material, drops from Wanderer-related sea areas, event rewards, shop exchange

name: 破晓者勋章
source: 破晓者船队专属突破材料，破晓者据点海域 Boss 掉落、周常任务奖励
sourceEn: Dawnbreaker faction exclusive ascension material, drops from Dawnbreaker stronghold sea bosses, weekly task rewards

name: 黑男爵封印
source: 黑男爵船队专属突破材料，黑男爵家族秘境掉落、限时活动、稀有兑换
sourceEn: Black Baron faction exclusive ascension material, drops from Black Baron family secret realms, limited events, rare exchange

name: 蓝波乐队信物
source: 蓝波乐队船队专属突破材料，音乐会活动、蓝波乐队专属任务、商店兑换
sourceEn: Ramble Band faction exclusive ascension material, concert events, Ramble Band exclusive quests, shop exchange

name: 铁矿石
source: 所有海域岛屿矿点采集、商店购买、敌舰掉落。前期最常见的船只升级材料
sourceEn: Mine at island ore nodes across all sea areas, shop purchase, enemy ship drops. The most common early-game ship upgrade material

name: 海木
source: 岛屿森林伐木、海怪掉落、港口木匠商店。用于船体结构升级
sourceEn: Logging at island forests, sea monster drops, port carpenter shops. Used for hull structure upgrades

name: 帆布
source: 港口裁缝店制作（需要植物纤维）、活动奖励。用于船帆升级，影响航速
sourceEn: Crafted at port tailor shops (requires plant fiber), event rewards. Used for sail upgrades, affects sailing speed

name: 船只图纸
source: 完成大型 Boss 战、海域深处宝箱、限时活动奖励、商店稀有兑换。用于船只改装
sourceEn: Complete major boss battles, deep-sea area chests, limited event rewards, shop rare exchange. Used for ship modifications

name: 大炮核心
source: Boss 战掉落、港口军工厂兑换、活动奖励。制造高阶大炮的核心部件
sourceEn: Boss battle drops, port armory exchange, event rewards. Core component for crafting high-tier cannons

name: 火药粉
source: 商店购买、岛屿矿点采集、敌舰掉落。制造各类炮弹的基础材料
sourceEn: Shop purchase, mine at island ore nodes, enemy ship drops. Base material for crafting all types of cannonballs

name: 远古零件
source: 古代遗迹宝箱、稀有 Boss 掉落、记忆之塔奖励。合成顶级装备的稀有材料
sourceEn: Ancient ruin chests, rare boss drops, Memory Tower rewards. Rare material for synthesizing top-tier equipment

name: 治疗朗姆酒
source: 港口酒馆购买、活动奖励、海域宝箱。战斗中恢复 HP
sourceEn: Buy at port taverns, event rewards, sea area chests. Restores HP during combat

name: 战斗大餐
source: 厨房烹饪（需要食材）、活动奖励、商店购买。战斗前提供攻击/防御 Buff
sourceEn: Cooked at kitchen (requires ingredients), event rewards, shop purchase. Provides attack/defense buffs before combat

name: 往日之影
source: 抽卡保底产出（与黑券船员并列）、稀有剧情事件、记忆之塔高层奖励。剧情系统核心收集物
sourceEn: Gacha pity output (alongside Black Ticket crew), rare story events, high-level Memory Tower rewards. Core collectible for the story system

name: 远古记忆碎片
source: 大记忆之塔挑战掉落、剧情 Boss 战、海域深处探索。用于解锁多结局分支
sourceEn: Drops from Memory Tower challenges, story boss battles, deep sea exploration. Used to unlock multiple ending branches
